The '''Capper spineflap''' was a type of creature that could be found on the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and its moon [[Rori/Legends|Rori]].<ref name="SWG" />

== Biology ==
Capper Spineflap is a butterfly-like creature with a stinger-like tail, a set of mantis arms, a pair of horns and a pair of red bug eyes.

==History==
{{Quote|I'd like some mountain spineflap wings. Also there's a mountain spineflap known as Sprywing. I'd like her talons.|[[Walker Luskeske]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:FaSB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Find a Security Beacon|Naboo}}</ref>}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the hunter [[Walker Luskeske]] asked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to kill mountain spineflaps in the [[Gallo Mountains/Legends|Gallo Mountains]], including [[Sprywing]], and bring him wings and talons as trophies.<ref name="SWG:FaSB" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:UnknownButbutFly.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Concept art for ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.]]
Capper spineflaps appeared in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online role-playing game developed by [[Sony]] and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
